name: Gahrron's Withering
summary: At Gahrron's Withering, the Scourge foul an old Lordaeron farm beside the road to the Eastern Plaguelands. A massive cauldron sends plague vapors into the air.

sections.title: From Harvest to Decay
sections.body: Before the Third War, this farm fed Lordaeron with grain. Then the Cult of the Damned and the Scourge swept across the land, and the fields fell silent. Now the farmstead is broken and derelict. Haunting visions, wailing wraiths, and restless spirits roam its ruined outbuildings under Scourge overseers sworn to the Lich King.

sections.title: The Cauldron and the Fall of Redpath
sections.body:
Cauldron Lord Soulwrath tends a massive Scourge plague cauldron in the heart of the blighted fields. Noxious miasma pours from it, poisoning the earth and driving natural life away.

This farm also marks the tragic end of the nearby Darrowshire tragedy. Alliance defenders confronted Captain Joseph Redpath here and struck him down after dark corruption claimed him. His shattered shield remains in the cursed soil.

faq.q: What was Gahrron's Withering called before the plague?
faq.answer: No record preserves the farm's name before the plague. Now it is known only as Gahrron's Withering. It was a working Lordaeron homestead until the Scourge devastated the countryside.

faq.q: Why is there a giant cauldron here?
faq.answer: The Scourge placed the cauldron here to spread plague vapors across the region. Cauldron Lord Soulwrath guards it so it can keep blighting the soil and air.

faq.q: Who was Joseph Redpath and why does he matter here?
faq.answer: Captain Joseph Redpath defended nearby Darrowshire and is named among the town's heroes. His cracked shield lies near the farmstead's barn, a relic of Darrowshire's tragic fall.

faq.q: Who controls Gahrron's Withering right now?
faq.answer: The Scourge holds the farm. Spectral wraiths, wailing deaths, and haunting visions haunt it under Cauldron Lord Soulwrath, a powerful necromantic officer.

angles.text: For Alliance veterans, this farm carries a grim memory. Captain Joseph Redpath's cracked shield remains in the cursed soil, left from Darrowshire's fall.
As a paladin, you find a clear target in the vile fumes from Cauldron Lord Soulwrath's cauldron and the restless dead on the ruined fields.
